name: Blu-Sub Mechatronics
description: Blu-Sub Mechatronics has generously sponsored UBC Subbots by providing subsea components for one of our AUVs, along with heavily discounted parts for our other projects. We highly recommend Blu-Sub for underwater robotics components, as they specialize in high-performance underwater thrusters, propulsion systems, and subsea technology. We are incredibly grateful for their continued support!

name: DarkVision
description: DarkVision creates innovative acoustic imaging devices that scan critical infrastructure for defects and failures. They have generously provided UBC Subbots with funding for our robotics projects.

name: Onshape
description: Onshape is an online Computer Aided Design tool that runs in your web browser. Only Onshape runs on any device, never crashes or loses data, and streamlines collaboration with branching & merging.

name: UBC Electrical and Computer Engineering
description: UBC ECE provides facilities, mentorship, and academic support that empower our electrical and software subteams to design and test cutting-edge autonomous systems.

name: UBC Applied Science
description: UBC Applied Science supports student engineering teams across disciplines, providing resources and a community for hands-on technical work.

name: UBC Mechanical Engineering
description: UBC Mechanical Engineering gives our team access to fabrication facilities and expertise to bring physical designs to life.

name: UBC Integrated Engineering
description: UBC Integrated Engineering (IGEN) connects students across engineering domains, reflecting the same cross-disciplinary approach that defines Subbots.

name: Camy's Pizza
description: Founder of the butter chicken pizza, Camy's Pizza has provided our team with a testing pool for the robot.
